app.title: FFmpeg Picture Converter 1.5.5
simple.mode.title: Simple Mode
exiftool.label: 🏷 exiftool
artifacts.label: 🔧 Artifacts
gamut.map.enable: Gamut Mapping (compress out-of-gamut instead of clipping)
tip.gamut.map: When on, out-of-gamut colors are desaturated toward same-luminance gray (GMO) instead of hard-clipping components to 0/1; in-gamut pixels stay byte-identical. Off by default (hard clipping). Only the in-process engine path honors it.
raw.target.label: RAW Output Color Target (RAW input only)
tip.raw.target: rec2020 (default) = prefer Rec.2020 expression, i.e. the current three-tier rule: HDR-transfer-capable containers and TIFF use bt2020, everything else uses bt709. auto = on top of that default, judge by the image's actual color usage and avoid Rec.2020 when it fits within bt709; applies only to SDR-transfer bt2020 tiers (currently the TIFF exception tier), HDR-transfer tiers are unaffected. rec709 = force bt709 + sRGB for maximum compatibility, overriding container capability.
cicp.always.on: ☑ CICP Color Tagging: Always Enabled (H.273 standard)
icc.mode.carry: ② Carry ICC — Keep source ICC or add standard ICC
icc.mode.bake: ③ Bake + Embed — Convert pixels & embed standard ICC
icc.mode.bakeonly: ④ Bake Only — Convert pixels, no ICC output
icc.help.tooltip:
Mode 1: No ICC (CICP only)
Mode 2: Carry ICC (keep source or add standard)
Mode 3: Bake + Embed standard ICC
Mode 4: Bake only (no ICC output)
CICP tagging always enabled
icc.bake.target: Bake target: follows the color space selected above
icc.source.space: Source color space (blank = auto-detect from file):
exiftool.missing: ExifTool not detected — metadata removal is unavailable (all metadata is preserved). Put exiftool under PLAN/exiftool/ and restart.
exiftool.mode.stripall: Metadata mode is "strip all" — the exiftool options have no effect
animation.hint: Blank=auto(follow source) | Loop: 0=infinite/-1=no loop/blank=default | Scale: blank=original
animation.duration.hint: Video to animation truncates to first N seconds, 0=all
gpu.encoder.warning: Recommend CPU encoder (mjpeg / libaom-av1 / libsvtav1) for best compatibility.
apng.note: APNG uses PNG encoder, lossless compression
preset.name: Preset
hw.hint: Hardware encoder only supports preset tuning; quality is controlled by the slider above
avif.aq.hint: 1=lowest, 8=default, 15=max (higher=more aggressive flat area compression); only takes effect while Spatial AQ is checked - uncheck it to turn AQ off
photon.noise.auto.hint: When enabled, ISO from each input photo's EXIF is read before encoding for photon noise, more accurate than a fixed value
preserve.ultrahdr: Preserve Ultra HDR gain map (decode & re-encode; disable = lossless repack but HDR lost)
gain.map.params: 🎛 Gain Map Parameters (active with ultrahdr encoder)
gain.map.hint: Image dimensions should be divisible by the scale factor | Default half-res, manual adjustment requires 'Advanced Codec Options' checked
gain.map.multichannel: RGB Multi-channel Gain Map (more accurate color, larger size)
jxr.note: JPEG XR Encoder — JxrEncApp (Microsoft reference implementation)
cache.dir.tooltip: Pipeline intermediate files (BMP/RAW/TIFF) location. Auto-cleaned after processing. Leave blank for auto-select.
append.png.tooltip: Append .png to output filename for compatibility with apps that cannot recognize .jxl/.avif. Only effective for JXL and AVIF formats.
concurrent.label: ({0} tasks concurrent)
rgba.unavailable: rgba1010102/rgbahalffloat requires ffmpeg with packed pixel format support (currently unavailable)
progress.title: Progress
preset.manager.title: Preset Manager
format.filter.title: Format Filter
color.strategy.carry.tip: No color conversion: source pixels and the ICC profile are preserved as-is. If the source has no ICC, it passes through only when its implied color space can be determined; otherwise it is rejected with advice.
color.strategy.cicponly.tip: Converts colors and strips the ICC profile, tagging color with CICP (H.273) only. Applies to containers that can carry CICP such as AVIF / HEIF / JXL.
color.strategy.manual.tip: Converts strictly according to the color space and primaries / transfer / matrix you set under Advanced Color, and writes both CICP and ICC tagging.
color.strategy.recommended.tip: Automatic: carries the source untouched when that is lossless, otherwise maps into the narrowest nameable superset containing the source gamut, and picks ICC / CICP tagging by container capability. HDR sources stay HDR where the format supports it.
detail.err.noexiftool.icc: exiftool not detected; cannot embed ICC
detail.status.undone: Reverted to the last read / saved state
detail.tip.embedicc: Pick an ICC profile and embed it into the current file
detail.title: Image Details
dng.linear.hint: Linear DNG only applies to demosaiced/linear input. Most camera RAW files are Bayer; choosing Linear will be rejected by the engine - keep Keep CFA.
dng.note.formats: Output is lossless JPEG or JPEG XL: JXL is smaller but slower to compress, JPEG is more compatible.
dng.note.input: Input supports DNG and common camera RAW (CR2 / CR3 / NEF / ARW / RAF / ORF, etc.), decoded by LibRaw.
dng.note.sensor: Highlight mode controls blown-out sensor data: Clip truncates it, Recover rebuilds it from the white point, Blend mixes both by weight.
dng.highlight.hint: Measured: CFA-preserving DNG output is unaffected by this option (all three modes are byte-identical); it only takes effect on the demosaic/linear path.

filter.title: Format Filter
filter.video.title: Video Formats
gainmap.base.note: SDR base gamut: sRGB has the widest compatibility; a Rec.2020 base keeps a wider gamut but requires a capable display.
gainmap.note: The gain map stores the difference between the SDR base and HDR luminance: ordinary viewers show SDR, HDR-capable ones show high dynamic range.
gainmap.quality.follow: Gain map quality follows the main image
gainmap.res.hint: Best when the image dimensions divide evenly by the scale factor; lower resolution means smaller size.
gainmap.res.title: Gain Map Resolution
gainmap.title: Gain Map (Ultra HDR)
hdr.mode.gainmap: Gain map HDR (SDR base + gain map; legacy viewers OK)
hdr.mode.traditional: Traditional HDR (native PQ/HLG; needs HDR viewer)

jxl.preserve.ultrahdr: Preserve Ultra HDR gain map (decode & re-encode; disable = lossless repack but HDR lost)
jxr.encoder.desc: Supports 8/16/32-bit, float, alpha channel, lossless / lossy

tip.color.range: Auto follows the input range (RGB/yuvj→PC, limited yuv→TV); you can also force TV/PC
tip.gainmap.enable: HDR implementation: gain map (SDR base + gain map, legacy viewers OK) or native PQ/HLG. Gain map applies to JPEG and AVIF
tip.gainmap.quality.follow: Keep gain map quality the same as the main image
tip.icc.modes: Read the description of the four ICC color management modes
tip.jpeg.fixed.code: Use fixed Huffman tables: better compatibility, slightly lower compression
tip.jpeg.noadaptive.quant: When off, a uniform quantization table is used: faster encoding, larger files at the same quality
tip.jxl.lossless.jpeg: For JPEG input, recompress losslessly without re-quantization: zero quality loss
tip.max.dimension.enable: Scale down proportionally to the longest edge; never enlarges
tip.max.dimension.limit: Pixel cap for the longest edge after scaling (1-7680)
